'''2012 Match Play Championship Day 1 Chris Westergard DS A Stunning Move''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Chris Westergard]] at [[2012 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).

Name as written on the Day 1 sheet.

== Deck info ==

* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
